## 变更 / Changes

说明问题与修改后的行为。Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## 验证 / Validation

列出执行的检查；界面改动附真实截图、语言与视口，注明未覆盖的场景。
List checks run. For UI changes, include real screenshots, languages, viewports and any untested flows.

## 素材 / Assets

若涉及模型、图片、字体或动作，记录来源、许可与修改，并更新 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md；不涉及则写 N/A。
For models, images, fonts or animation, document provenance, permission and changes in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; otherwise write N/A.

贡献约定 / Contribution terms: [中文](https://github.com/xiaoiver/strange-loops/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [English](https://github.com/xiaoiver/strange-loops/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.en.md)
